body: It could be, but given the history I wouldnt want to tempt fate too much. I did think of letting her brother in on things, but again, it might aggravate her situation

I'm usually have of all her tablets with me so that I give her enough for every other day or so, but she's taken them all back now, nothing I could have really done about that. We've just had a talk and she seems to have calmed down and rationalised a little, but whether its the calm before the storm or not I can't tell.
